status: ALL FINDINGS FIXED at 4.6.11 and re-validated at 5.0.0 (rename-only release over 4.6.11; statistically identical). Bless precondition satisfied (RIGOR R18: no open fixable finding).

findings.fix: Exact order-statistic inversion (qsignrank/qwilcox) + tie-corrected uniroot; zeros dropped for signed-rank. New module _wilcox_ci.py.
findings.revalidation: exact rank-sum/signed-rank CIs machine-exact vs R; approx CIs within R's uniroot tol (~1e-4).
findings.divergence: HL confidence interval used empirical percentiles of the Walsh averages (wrong endpoints for small n) while labelled "exact".

findings.fix: Cap the correction at min(0.5, |Δ|/Σ(1/n)), matching R.
findings.revalidation: CI matches R to machine precision.
findings.divergence: 2-sample CI always used the full 0.5 continuity correction (interval wider than R when proportions are close).

findings.fix: Emit R's one-sample KS ties warning.
findings.divergence: one-sample KS handled ties silently; R warns "ties should not be present".

findings.fix: Add R's second-order correction: p = Pr1 + w2·(Pr2−Pr1), Pr2 at df+4.
findings.revalidation: Mauchly p matches afex to machine precision.
findings.divergence: Mauchly p used only the first-order chi-square, omitting R's second-order (Box) term (~1e-3 off).

findings.fix: Raise ValidationError on probs ∉ [0,1], matching R.
findings.divergence: probs outside [0,1] were silently clamped to min/max instead of raising (fail-loud gap).

note: No test statistic or default p-value on valid input was ever wrong (all matched R to machine precision at 4.6.10). The five findings were CI/warning/diagnostic/invalid-input conventions; all fixed and re-validated at 4.6.11. 5.0.0 is a rename-only release over the blessed 4.6.11 line; every G1/G2 number reproduces 4.6.11 bit-for-bit.
